notes:
I couldn't do this research, so I have no notes on Jeremiah 13 for you.

I tried to load six sources in one batch: Enduring Word, the Ellicott, Gill and Pulpit commentaries on BibleHub, Precept Austin and the NET Bible notes. A bug in my code stopped me from reading what came back. When I tried to fix it, the tool told me I had no more tool calls left for this turn. So I never read any of those pages, and I didn't get to search the denominational sites, the scholarly sites or the Catholic and Orthodox sites.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. Without anything I can cite, any note I wrote now would come from memory, so I've left them all out.

If you send the request again, I can start over with fewer sources per call so one bad result doesn't stop the run:
1. **The traditional reading:** the verse-by-verse sources above.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** the Reformed, Baptist, Methodist, Pentecostal and Lutheran sites. Verse 23 (the leopard and his spots) is probably the likeliest place to find real disagreement, but I'll only report it if the sources show it.
3. **Other views:** the NET notes and Bible Odyssey for modern scholarship, and New Advent, Catholic.com and OCA.org for Catholic and Orthodox readings.

You can also save time by naming the verses that matter most to you, and I'll go deeper on those.
